context: Digest at artifact-write time, recompute at gate-check time, reject unknown SHAs, and state the threat model (integrity against accident and drift, not against a malicious operator - no signing infra). Depends on release-readiness-py310-utc-compat (same file: scripts/release_readiness_check.py).
description:
2026-07-21 adversarial UAT review finding (P2): the release-evidence chain proves committed field values, not that a sweep ran. capture_run_source_info records HEAD SHA + dirty at sweep start (tests/uat/orchestrator.py:72-82; git failure swallowed to sha='unknown', dirty=False at :96-98) -> per-stage uat_gate_summary.json -> make uat-gate-check checks stage set/order, SHA equality, dirtiness, per-stage green (tests/uat/gate_summary.py:189-263, tests/uat/_cli.py:215-309) -> scripts/release_readiness_check.py:253-308 checks verdict/freshness/ancestry in validate-release-pr.yml. No hash binds the committed _project/release-evidence/uat-gate-summary.json to any stage artifact; a hand-authored green file with a real develop SHA and fresh timestamp passes CI. gate_summary.py:221-228 checks SHA equality only, so all-'unknown' stages get a green combined verdict and a false local APPROVE (CI later fails closed on the ancestry check - no soundness hole, but a lying local gate).

This confirms and generalizes the untracked blind-spot _project/blind-spots/2026-07-18-190500-evidence-tree-sha-provenance-mismatch.md ('nothing binds measured evidence to the tree that produced it'); close it with this item.

Scope: (1) per-stage digests of cells.jsonl + accounting sidecar + uat_lifecycle.log recorded in the stage summary at write time; (2) aggregate digest in the combined evidence; (3) gate-check recomputes digests from the named stage dirs and rejects mismatch or sha='unknown'; (4) release_readiness_check optionally verifies an attached digest manifest; (5) document the residual trust boundary honestly in _project/release-evidence/README.md.

anti_patterns.dont: claim tamper-proof provenance from self-computed digests
anti_patterns.instead: state the threat model in the README; treat signing as explicitly out of scope
anti_patterns.why: digests computed on the operator machine can be regenerated by the same hand that forges evidence; without signing this is integrity against accident/drift, not malice

anti_patterns.dont: keep APPROVing sha='unknown' locally because CI fails closed later
anti_patterns.instead: reject unknown at gate-check with a message naming the git failure
anti_patterns.why: the operator acts on the local APPROVE; a lying local gate erodes trust in the whole chain

anti_patterns.dont: make CI re-run sweeps to verify evidence
anti_patterns.instead: verify digests over committed/attached artifacts only
anti_patterns.why: sweeps are hours long; the CI gate is evidence-integrity + freshness, not re-execution

preserves.behavior: Evidence file format stays additive - older evidence without digests fails with a clear 'regenerate evidence' message, not a crash.
Existing gate-check checks (stage set/order, SHA equality, dirtiness, per-stage green, sidecar, explorer-smoke, floors, Docker ordering) all unchanged.
release_readiness_check's fail-closed behavior on missing evidence unchanged.

prior_art.concept: the recorded provenance concern this item closes
build_combined_evidence - the aggregation seam the digests ride through
